chapter_note: The oldest teaching layer is the five-fold powers succession (year, month, day, hour, moment) in ¶3-6 — a systematic enumerated teaching mapping cosmic temporal authorities to generational lifespan, classic substrate. The problem statement (¶2) with its zodiac observation is also clearly old. The second half introduces a complementary light-withdrawal explanation (¶7) and a birth-mechanism teaching (¶10) whose substrate status is less certain — the editorial fatigue score (0.74) and substrate vocabulary dropping to 0.00 in the second half suggest editorial extension. Gardner confirms the two-section structure: powers explanation (144.15-146.8) followed by a 'more immediate lesson' (146.8-147.17). The chapter's low teaching purity score (0.133) reflects the absence of canonical substrate markers (zoomorphic forms, metals) rather than absence of old teaching — the five-fold powers nomenclature is differently structured.

paragraphs.core_text: about Adam, the first man. When he was fashioned, how did they sculpt him? Or, how did they beget him? Rather, is his begetting like the begetting that is brought forth today, amongst humankind; or not? Does a distinction exist between his birth and the one that they bring forth today?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame attribution and honorific: 'Once again, a Babylonian catechumen questioned the enlightener, saying to him: Speak with me, my master, and instruct me' — formulaic frame wrapping a substantive cosmological question.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The question defines the teaching's problem structure: why does Adam's generation differ from the present? 'Today' here functions as a cosmic-temporal reference (era of moment-powers) rather than editorial present anchor. The question about sculpting/begetting Adam is substantive — it sets up the cosmological mechanism the five-fold teaching will explain.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [ ... ] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?
paragraphs.temporal_note: This is the extended problem statement — cosmological observation that the zodiac (cosmic structure) hasn't changed, yet generations have diminished. The observation 'the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions' is diagnostic substrate: it establishes a cosmic paradox that requires the five-fold powers teaching to resolve. The 'today' references are within the cosmic-temporal comparison structure, not editorial application. No dialogue frame markers present.

paragraphs.core_text: They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame with honorific: 'And for his part our enlightener, in his deep wisdom and his great understanding, speaks to this catechumen who had questioned him:' — hagiographic attribution.
paragraphs.temporal_note: This is the heart of the chapter's substrate: a five-fold enumeration of cosmic temporal authorities. The systematic structure — five types, five names, five positions, five houses, five masters, hierarchical ordering — is classic oldest-layer enumerated teaching. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system: sphere → positions → powers → mastery hierarchy. The enumeration integrity is pristine.

paragraphs.core_text: So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the five-fold teaching — applies the hierarchy to generation. The year-powers reign first, producing the longest-lived generations. Adam and Sethel are cosmic-historical figures within the system (not contemporary references). The span 'from the beginning of creation till the end of the world' maps the entire cosmic cycle. Pure process description — impersonal, systematic.

paragraphs.core_text: After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second iteration of the succession teaching: year-powers → month-powers. The correspondence is systematic: as months are to years, so are month-generation lifespans to year-generation lifespans. Both sides of the mapping stay within the cosmic temporal system. Contains lacunae restoration in brackets.

paragraphs.core_text: When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their {conduit} is less than that of the months and the days.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the five-fold succession: months → days, then compresses hours and moments into a summary. The {conduit} term is interesting — could be a scribal substitution or a cosmological technical term for the channel of life/light through which generations receive their measure. The five-fold teaching is now structurally complete: year > month > day > hour > moment, each producing proportionally diminished generations.

paragraphs.core_text: The life span of the people has drawn in to nothing. Their days have diminished. Their years have become less; because the life and the ligh[t that] was in the world in these first generations was more than that of today. Indeed, because of this have they diminished in their stature. Their life span has become less for them.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame: 'Our enlightener speaks to that Babylonian catechumen:' and application address: 'Do you see, how near the end of the world approaches?' — the former is hagiographic attribution, the latter is audience-directed application voice that points the teaching toward the listener's situation.
paragraphs.temporal_note: This introduces a second causal explanation: light withdrawal from the world. The concept is within the cosmic system (progressive extraction of light), but it's presented in application voice after the complete five-fold teaching. The editorial fatigue data shows substrate dropping to 0.00 in the second half. The light-withdrawal explanation may be complementary substrate (describing the same process from a different angle) or editorial extension applying the teaching. Genuine uncertainty here — flagged.

Pure dialogue frame — the catechumen recaps what he was told. No new teaching content. 'Once again speaks this Babylonian catechumen to our enlightener: I entreat you, my master!' is formulaic. The rest summarizes ¶3-7. High dialogue_frame score (12.5) confirms. This is editorial machinery creating a transition to the next question.

paragraphs.core_text: By what sort of birth was the entire offspring of mankind made from one man and one woman, Adam and Eve?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed frame formula: 'Now, can you recount to me this other (matter):' — request formula wrapping a substantive cosmological question.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Substantive question about the mechanism of human propagation from Adam and Eve. This defines the second teaching topic — how one pair populated the earth. The question reveals the teaching structure and belongs to the oldest layer per the Persian pedagogical tradition principle.

paragraphs.core_text: For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. Thus, again, even their offspring is much more than the offspring of this tim[e]. They were spending a longer time [ ... ] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [ ... ] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed: (1) dialogue frame + commendation: 'The enlightener speaks to that catechumen: While well do you ask for this lesson, so yet know and understand it!' (2) editorial present-day comparison: 'because the offspring from the generation of the people of old, who they bore into the world, differ greatly from those of today. Their conception and their birth is not like latter births, brought forth nowadays from the woman's uterus.' — 'today' and 'nowadays' anchor to editorial present.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The specific numerical detail (5-6 per womb) feels like old teaching — editors don't typically invent such precise cosmological mechanism. The correspondence: greater light → longer gestation → more offspring per womb → rapid population from one pair. Both sides map within the cosmic system (light quantity → biological mechanism). However, this falls in the chapter's second half where editorial fatigue is strong. Genuine uncertainty about whether this is pre-compilation substrate or Mani's own teaching elaboration. Lacunae present.

paragraphs.core_text: For, they whom they beget today, in these last generations, they stand diminished and maimed. And, indeed, one by one do they bri[ng t]hem [forth] from a single womb. Hardly two, or [l]ess or more. They are even made ugly in their aspect, being diminished in their size, and feeble in their limbs.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed moral/editorial judgment: 'Their teachings and [their] considerations are full of wickedness, they are evil. They are drowning, and they end their life span suffering. Even death catches them in haste.' — shifts from physical-cosmological description (diminished size, one per womb) to moral characterization of contemporary humanity. The physical description completes the birth-count contrast from ¶10; the moral judgment is editorial application.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The birth-count contrast (one per womb vs. 5-6) completes the teaching structure from ¶10. The physical diminishment (smaller, uglier, feebler) maps the cosmic process of light withdrawal onto bodily form — still within the cosmic system. But 'Their teachings and considerations are full of wickedness' crosses from physical description to moral commentary on contemporary humanity — the mapping leaves the cosmic system. 'Today' is embedded in the substrate sentence and cannot be cleanly removed without paraphrase.

Pure closing formula — catechumen thanks the enlightener. 'When that catechumen had listened... he paid homage and gave glory' is standard session-closing frame. 'I thank you, my master, for you have satisfied my heart' is devotional closure. Institutional vocabulary (catechumen, 6.82) confirms editorial layer. No teaching content.
